events.continuity_hook: Adds a brief logistics check to the Central Oregon utility trip after the booked plan gets day-before operating details.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm the drive timing, gate arrival plan, rental counter hours, hotel parking plan, and return-to-airport buffer without changing reservations.
events.scenario_brief: The Bend facility sends a final gate map, a dawn roadwork notice on US-97, and a changed forklift slot for the demo skid. Jonah keeps the booked Tuesday flights, Bend hotel, and rental car, but wants the Tuesday Redmond-to-Bend drive buffer, Wednesday early departure from the hotel, parking approach, and Thursday airport return buffer tightened. Nothing needs rebooking unless the rental counter hours or hotel parking note create a problem.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a distributor-training trip after the Central Oregon startup is ready to run.
events.interaction_goal: Build a flight, rental-car, and hotel shortlist around the fixed training windows, equipment delivery, evening prep, and practical dining.
events.scenario_brief: A Nebraska distributor asks Jonah to lead a Tuesday afternoon dealer training and a Wednesday morning operator demo at a nearby municipal facility. He needs Monday Bay Area-to-Omaha options, with Kansas City as a possible lower-fare but longer-drive airport, and he wants no more than one reasonable connection. Hotels should compare the airport, west-side business parks, and a riverfront area for commute time, guest rating, parking, and dinner access. The open items are the training case delivery and whether Wednesday adds an afternoon manager debrief.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Midwest distributor trip once the equipment and Wednesday start location are clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Narrow the outbound flight, hotel area, car pickup timing, and return window before booking.
events.scenario_brief: The training case is confirmed for Monday noon, but the Wednesday operator demo moves across the river with a 7:30 a.m. arrival request. Jonah wants to narrow the plan between a west-side hotel that is easier after landing and a riverfront hotel that is better for the early drive and meals. The remaining question is whether the ride-along ends near 1:00 p.m. or closer to 3:00 p.m., which determines a Wednesday evening return versus a Thursday morning return.

events.continuity_hook: Finalizes the Nebraska distributor trip once the ride-along end time and Monday dinner location settle.
events.interaction_goal: Book the flights, hotel, rental car, room note, seats, and concise training agenda.
events.scenario_brief: The distributor confirms the ride-along will wrap by early afternoon and adds a Monday dinner with the sales manager near the riverfront. Jonah books the Monday afternoon one-stop Bay Area-to-Omaha routing with a comfortable connection, a Wednesday evening return, a compact rental car, and the riverfront hotel with strong guest feedback, parking, and nearby restaurants. The room note asks for a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and window seats are selected where available.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new municipal utility site visit after the distributor training is booked.
events.interaction_goal: Create a flight, rental-car, and hotel shortlist that protects the early plant entry while keeping a realistic Thursday option.
events.scenario_brief: A South Texas coastal utility asks Jonah to review a reuse pilot after inconsistent permeate readings, with a Tuesday 6:00 a.m. plant walkdown and a Wednesday afternoon city staff briefing. He needs Monday Bay Area-to-Corpus Christi options that leave time for rental-car pickup and slide prep, plus a San Antonio fallback if the smaller-airport connections look fragile. Hotels should compare an airport-adjacent property against a bayfront property with better dinner access and solid guest feedback. The open items are whether a Thursday procurement meeting is added and whether the chemical-feed parts reach the plant before he flies.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the South Texas utility trip from comparison to booking once the parts and Thursday meeting timing are clear.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights, rental car, hotel reservation, third night, room note, seats, and two-day plant agenda.
events.scenario_brief: The utility confirms the parts are onsite and adds a Thursday procurement meeting ending around 10:30 a.m. Jonah books the Monday afternoon one-stop Bay Area-to-Corpus Christi itinerary through Houston rather than the longer San Antonio drive, reserves a compact SUV for the plant road, and chooses the bayfront hotel because it has stronger guest feedback, parking, and easier evening meals. The stay extends through Wednesday night, the room note asks for a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and the return is set for Thursday midafternoon with window seats where available.
